item.title: Shootings at school and home in northeastern British Columbia leave 10 dead including shooter
item.description: Canadian police say eight people including a suspect are dead after a shooting at a small school in British Columbia, with two more found dead at a home believed to be connected to the incident. Police say more than 25 people were injured, including two with life-threatening injuries. Royal Canadian Mounted Police say they have identified a female suspect, but did not release the name, adding that the shooter's motive remains unclear.
